title: Prolonging fruit shelf-life with a graphitic carbon nitride (GCN) incorporating biopolymer composite: layer-by-layer assembled coating
content:
Sustainable Food Technol., 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5FB00744E, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Md. Sajib Hossain, Md. Didarul Islam, Anik Das, M. Mehedi Hasan, Md. Mahfuzur Rahman, Samrat Mukhopadhyay
This study presents a novel, biodegradable, and multifunctional layer-by-layer (LbL) coating composition of sodium alginate (SA), chitosan (CAS), and graphitic carbon nitride (GCN) for efficient fruit preservation.
